intended_object: The group-valued functor of points R ↦ Hom_{Spec K}(Spec R, D_n) of the diagonal group scheme D_n ⊂ GL_n over the commutative ring K, on commutative K-algebras (from the docstring and the module context).
explanation: The body composes `algSpec K` (R ↦ Spec R as a scheme over Spec K, taken op-wise) with `yonedaGrp.obj D`, Mathlib's group-valued Yoneda functor for a group object. The result is exactly R ↦ Hom_{Spec K}(Spec R, D_n) with the group structure coming from D_n's group-object structure, i.e. the standard functor of points of D_n on affine test schemes. Here D_n is Spec of the GL_n coordinate ring modulo the Hopf ideal generated by the off-diagonal entries. The file confirms this object: it gives a closed immersion D_n → GL_n and a natural isomorphism (`diagonalGroupPointsIso`) between this functor and R ↦ invertible diagonal matrices over R. The definition is stated over any commutative ring K and any finite index type n, which is the natural generality. It is a specific object built from general Mathlib tools, so it is not too narrow.
